name: 72211 · Little Rock, AR
findings: ZIP 72211 (Little Rock) has 126 nonprofit organizations. 68 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 60 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 72211 (Little Rock) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
